categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the chemical raw materials and chemical products manufacturing industry, focusing on chemical pesticides manufacturing. Its main product lines include herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, and other crop protection products. The business model integrates pesticide raw material production and formulation, with a global marketing network and overseas registration of pesticide products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies for various pesticide classes such as phenoxycarboxylic acid herbicides, triazine herbicides, cyclohexenone herbicides, trichloromethylthio fungicides, and triazolinone herbicides. It emphasizes clean production methods that reduce toxic byproducts and energy consumption, continuous and automated production processes, and environmentally friendly formulations like water-based seed treatments and oil suspensions. The company also invests in R&D for new green synthesis routes and efficient production technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are agricultural producers and distributors globally, with a focus on crop protection markets. It serves end markets in over 100 countries, including major agricultural regions such as Latin America (notably Brazil and Argentina), North America, Asia-Pacific, Africa, and Europe. The company targets both B2B and B2C segments, with increasing emphasis on direct-to-customer sales and branded products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a broad global footprint with manufacturing bases in China (Weifang, Qingdao, Ningxia) and overseas locations including Argentina, Spain, and the United States. It operates subsidiaries and sales offices in more than 100 countries worldwide, covering key agricultural markets in Latin America, North America, Europe, Asia, and Africa. The company is actively expanding its presence in emerging markets and strengthening its global registration and marketing platforms.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pesticide supply chain. It manufactures active ingredients (raw materials) and formulates pesticide products (formulations), while also engaging in global marketing, product registration, and distribution. It integrates upstream raw material procurement with downstream product development and sales, maintaining control over the full value chain from factory to farm.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on enhancing global operational capabilities, expanding overseas product registrations, and building a rapid market entry platform. R&D priorities include developing clean, green, and efficient production technologies for key pesticide active ingredients and formulations, advancing continuous and automated manufacturing, and innovating environmentally friendly pesticide formulations. The company also emphasizes strengthening its global marketing network, brand building, and expanding biological pesticide product lines.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of chemical pesticide products, including herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, and related formulations. Revenue is derived from both export sales and domestic sales, with a significant portion from overseas markets. The company employs a combination of traditional export sales and overseas product registration with local brand sales (B2C and B2B models).
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading global crop protection company originating from China, leveraging its integrated supply chain and global registration capabilities. It competes with multinational pesticide manufacturers, especially in the non-patent crop protection market segment. The company emphasizes its rapid market entry platform, broad product portfolio, and internationalized team as competitive advantages to strengthen its market share and industry leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 13.3 billion RMB, representing a 15.77% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about 450 million RMB, though it declined compared to the prior year. The company has shown steady revenue growth with expanding global market penetration, despite some profit volatility due to exchange rate fluctuations and market conditions. Total assets reached over 15.3 billion RMB with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique business model combining traditional export with overseas product registration to provide comprehensive crop protection solutions globally. It highlights advanced manufacturing technologies that ensure environmentally friendly, cost-effective, and high-quality pesticide products. Its rapid market entry platform and extensive global registration portfolio enable quick adaptation to diverse markets and regulatory environments, delivering differentiated value through product innovation, brand presence, and supply chain integration.
